Bodycote Agrees to $2.2 Billion Takeover Offer From Veritas
Bodycote agreed to a takeover proposal from private equity firm Veritas Capital valuing it at around 1.64 billion pounds ($2.22 billion) including debt.

Under the terms of the agreement, Bodycote shareholders will be entitled to receive 940 pence for each share held. This comprises 932.8 pence in cash per share as well as a 7.2 pence interim dividend.

Bodycote said the 932.8 pence cash offer, not including the dividend, reflected a 36.5% premium to its three-month volume-weighted average share price of 683.4 pence prior to May 22, when takeover speculation first emerged.
"The board remains highly confident in Bodycote's prospects and believes that this offer recognizes that value today and is therefore recommending it to shareholders," Chairman Daniel Dayan said.
